title: IKY Scholarships for Foreign Nationals
field: All fields (postgraduate study, doctoral and postdoctoral research, Modern Greek language and culture)
description: Scholarships granted by Greece's State Scholarships Foundation to foreign nationals for postgraduate study, doctoral and postdoctoral research, or courses in Modern Greek language and culture at Greek institutions.
amount: Monthly stipend and, for degree study, a tuition contribution (varies by call)

title: Onassis Foundation Scholarships for Foreigners
provider: Alexander S. Onassis Public Benefit Foundation
field: Humanities, social sciences, political science, law, economics, architecture, fine arts, Hellenic studies
description: Scholarships for non-Greek nationals to pursue master's or doctoral study, postdoctoral research, or a research stay at a Greek university or research institution, with priority given to Hellenic studies and related fields.
amount: Monthly stipend, tuition allowance, travel allowance and, for research, a one-off installation grant

title: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki Scholarships for International Students
description: Institutional tuition scholarships and fee reductions for international students admitted to an English-taught postgraduate programme at Greece's largest university.
amount: Partial to full tuition fee reduction (varies by programme)

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Greece-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Greek institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
